domain: choosing a phone for elderly parents
base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose a suitable phone. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: 我想给我妈买个手机当生日礼物，看了几款，帮我参谋参谋

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 phones for mom's birthday: iPhone 15 (128GB), OPPO A3 Pro, Redmi 14C

iPhone 15 (128GB): 4999 yuan, iOS system, 6.1 inch screen, no built-in elder mode. OPPO A3 Pro: 1999 yuan, ColorOS with simple mode, currently sold out locally — only available via official online store with 5-7 day shipping. Redmi 14C: 1099 yuan, MIUI with dedicated elder mode, 6.88 inch large screen, in stock at the Mi Store near mom's house.
Mom has presbyopia and is not tech-savvy, needs large screen and simple dedicated elder interface

constraints.value: Maximum phone budget is about 1500 yuan
constraints.surface_form: 这个月房贷4500，水电保险1500，买菜生活费1500，工资一共九千，剩下也就一千五能动
inference_chain: Phone budget capped at approximately 1500 yuan

constraints.value: Must have the phone in hand by this Saturday — cannot wait for shipping
constraints.surface_form: 我妈生日这周六，我想当面送给她，到时候直接帮她设置好
inference_chain: Wants to give it in person and set it up together
Therefore must purchase in-store or have it delivered before Saturday
OPPO A3 Pro (5-7 day online shipping) cannot arrive in time

constraints.value: Phone must have a built-in dedicated elder mode and large screen, because mom has presbyopia and is not tech-savvy
constraints.surface_form: 我妈老花眼挺严重的，智能手机用不太明白，得要那种有专门老人模式、字大图标大的
inference_chain: Mom has serious presbyopia → needs large screen with large text
Mom is not tech-savvy → needs dedicated built-in elder mode
iPhone 15 has no native elder mode and only 6.1 inch screen → eliminated

hidden_state.value: You are someone buying a phone as a birthday gift for your mom. You are choosing between 3 phones (iPhone 15, OPPO A3 Pro, Redmi 14C). You will share phone details, your budget situation, timing needs, and mom's usability requirements across several turns. Your colleague and friend will praise iPhone and OPPO respectively. At the very end, you will say you need to buy one today and ask which one to get — you must NEVER name which phone you think is correct, let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, matter-of-fact person. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. When sharing info about colleagues or friends, you mention it casually as conversation filler, not as a deliberate signal.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation and keeps drift turns natural

aims.success_criteria: Agent recommends Redmi 14C — the only phone within 1500 budget, available in-store by Saturday, and with dedicated elder mode and large screen for mom's presbyopia
aims.conversation_goal: Commit-action probe: agent must determine Redmi 14C is the only viable choice and recommend it

ground_truth.answer: The user should buy the Redmi 14C (1099 yuan). iPhone 15 (4999 yuan) far exceeds the 1500 yuan budget and lacks built-in elder mode. OPPO A3 Pro (1999 yuan) exceeds the budget and cannot arrive before Saturday due to 5-7 day shipping. Only Redmi 14C satisfies all three constraints: within budget (1099 < 1500), available in-store at the nearby Mi Store for immediate pickup before Saturday, and has dedicated elder mode with a 6.88 inch large screen suitable for mom's presbyopia.
required_elements: Agent recommends Redmi 14C as the phone to buy
Agent shows that iPhone 15 at 4999 yuan exceeds the derived budget of approximately 1500 yuan (from 9000 salary minus 4500 mortgage minus 1500 utilities minus 1500 groceries)
Agent shows that OPPO A3 Pro at 1999 yuan exceeds the 1500 yuan budget AND cannot arrive by Saturday due to 5-7 day online-only shipping
Agent identifies that Redmi 14C meets mom's usability needs with its dedicated elder mode and 6.88 inch large screen for presbyopia
forbidden_elements: Recommending iPhone 15 (4999 far exceeds 1500 budget and has no elder mode)
Recommending OPPO A3 Pro (1999 exceeds 1500 budget and 5-7 day shipping misses Saturday birthday)
Ignoring the budget constraint derived from monthly expenses
Ignoring the Saturday birthday deadline when evaluating OPPO availability
Ignoring mom's presbyopia and tech-illiteracy when evaluating iPhone (no elder mode)
Asking the user which phone they decided on instead of computing the answer from constraints
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint (salary 9000 - expenses 7500 = 1500 max): iPhone 15 4999 eliminated (233% over), OPPO A3 Pro 1999 eliminated (33% over). Timing constraint (birthday Saturday, need in-store): OPPO A3 Pro eliminated (online only, 5-7 day shipping). Usability constraint (presbyopia + not tech-savvy → needs elder mode + large screen): iPhone 15 eliminated (no elder mode, only 6.1 inch). Only Redmi 14C (1099 yuan, in stock at nearby Mi Store, dedicated elder mode, 6.88 inch screen) passes all 3 constraints. Despite 4 drift turns praising iPhone 15 and OPPO A3 Pro, the agent must respect the hard constraints and recommend Redmi 14C.

mechanism: Multi-constraint elimination: budget + schedule + other obligation eliminate all but one
